trial.binary_policy: the prior trial-small-boss webp/jpg/png share visually corrupted source pixels and are retired even if their containers decode

rules.limit: 每位顧客、電話及地址限申請一次

rules.product_authority: formal product images are for product surfaces only; products-v3 remains physical identity reference and 180cc uses the exact approved HD product master
rules.customer_main_visual: formal product media for product surfaces; valid detailed DMs only for DM surfaces; trial uses the approved component with mascot support plus formal 30cc product image
rules.drink30: small bare glass jar, no label, no shape/proportion changes
rules.drink180: foil pouch, no pouch/proportion changes, no DM poster as main product image
rules.piece_weight_policy: 9.375g and 18.75g are approximate detail data only, not product/DM main-image copy
rules.guard_policy: validate product image, valid detailed DM, trial component and real-product identity separately; reject corrupt, low-resolution, wrong-role or retired media
